note: The embed's test-mode tour bundle is fetched cross-origin (session.livechatData.serverUrl is localhost, the page is 127.0.0.1) and neither /web/bundle nor /web/assets/esm carries CORS headers, so the browser blocks it and odoo.isTourReady never resolves. Production never loads a bundle cross-origin from the embed -- boot.js only does it under session.test_mode -- so closing this means deciding whether Odoo's asset graph may be served to any origin, which is a policy call rather than a repair.
